display_name: LoRa Full R69 结构适配同包 W24 源对照
description: 复用 LoRa 合法源训练的 256 点 R69 架构适配及其源门控，投影回同一 8192 点 Full 接收包并接冻结 E104，对既有 60 个源 V 包做 low urban 与 clean 对照。
authorization: 用户要求建立同数据集匹配 DURA 对照并保持固定权重来源；LoRa 与 WiSig 不跨契约继承。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI FP32 CUDA prediction and independent CPU truth-last scorer

data.representation: 8192 native Full received IQ; six normalized 256-point chirp windows; E104 W24 original head
data.physical_ids_ref: Exact previously exposed 60-packet b200_1 panel in 20261128-phase1-dura-realgain-crossdata-s2026112845-r02/lora/screen.npz; exact direct predictions checked
data.exposure: source V panel and historical baseline already exposed, no target access

permissions.claim_scope: No training or threshold fitting. Existing LoRa R69 model, original source gate and half correction; true labels only after both screen views fixed.

checkpoint.initialization: LoRa-trained R65 from scratch and R69 student; no cross-dataset weight transfer

sources.role: frozen LoRa Full source-trained R69 and source-only gate
same LoRa contract, frozen E104 reader and archived real-gain predictions

checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed source-trained half-dose with frozen gate; no training, no target-based selection. Report as LoRa R69 architecture adaptation, not original WiSig fixed DURA v1 checkpoint.

execution.gpu_policy: one worker on first available GPU of 7,2,3,6,1,4 with >=8192 MiB free, protecting GPU0/5 current shared experiment and other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop this run on source contract/checkpoint mismatch, smoke bypass or failed R69 forward, nonfinite output, differing physical IDs or direct predictions, output collision, or truth-before-freeze. Preserve other owner tasks.

rows.method: LoRa Full source-trained R69 architecture adaptation, frozen source gate, half-dose, W24 E104
rows.seed_notes: Frozen source-trained model and deterministic historical panel; no new training, augmentation or support.

notes: Prediction and truth-last score only; not a new candidate or full matrix.
This structural LoRa adaptation uses distinct weights and preprocessing; the fixed WiSig DURA v1 result remains unavailable under LoRa contract.
Candidate pairing later requires its own complete frozen prediction artifact and exact physical IDs.
